import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/punch_list/available_final_approvers?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&query=SOME_STRING_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
